findings.summary: is_logged_in() catches every Exception and returns False, so a network or DNS failure reads as 'logged out' and the cause is lost before auto-login/credentials_login runs.
findings.suggestion: Narrow the except to playwright's TimeoutError (plus the 403/non-200 path already handled), or log the exception type name (never the message or headers) so a logged-out result can be told apart from a connectivity failure.

findings.summary: --dry-run skips validate_rows(), which only runs inside post(). A dry run can print a summary for rows (e.g. a negative weight_loss_pct from end > start, or a loss outside 0..100) that the real run would reject.
findings.suggestion: Call CropsterConnector.validate_rows(rows) in the dry-run branch before printing, so the preview matches what post() would accept.
